snippet.title: Shadowstone | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Unseen horrors and challenges await you in Shadowstone, a new 1-4 player tactics roguelite game from developer Secret Door and publisher Dreamhaven. 

Survive a brutal world where monsters lurk in every corner, and victory is not always guaranteed. Play as one of the Lich’s experiments (Witch, Pyromancer, Berserker, and Ranger) as they attempt to escape his clutches. 

Embark solo or with a party of up to 4 players as you upgrade powerful spells, build overpowered hero synergies, and try to outlast the shadows that follow at every step. 

Coming to Steam Early Access in 2026. 

—

Wishlist on Steam: https://dhvn.gg/sstone-steam
Wishlist on Epic Games Store: https://dhvn.gg/sstone-epic

Join our Discord: discord.gg/secretdoor  
Follow us on socials: http://linktr.ee/dreamhavenent
